products.name: Tea Tree Face Wash
products.description: A low-foaming, surfactant-gel cleanser formulated to lift sebum, particulate debris and product residue from the stratum corneum — using a mild surfactant base calibrated to solubilise oil without stripping the intercellular lipids that make up the skin's barrier. Its formulation is built around tea tree oil, whose principal compound terpinen-4-ol has documented antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activity against the bacteria implicated in acne, helping calm existing blemishes. Massage onto damp skin for 30-60 seconds before rinsing; skin is left clean without the tightness or reactive dryness associated with harsher, high-pH cleansers.
products.what_makes_potent:
• Antimicrobial Botanical: Tea tree oil, whose principal compound terpinen-4-ol has documented antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activity against the bacteria implicated in acne, helping calm existing blemishes.
• Soap-free, paraben-free and formulated close to skin's natural pH to preserve the acid mantle.
• Formulated and stability-tested for consistent performance, pH and sensory profile across every batch.
• Actives sourced from established global and Ayurvedic ingredient suppliers, manufactured in small, quality-controlled batches.

products.name: Under Eye Serum with Hyaluronic Peptides
products.description: A lightweight formula calibrated for the periorbital skin, which is roughly a third the thickness of facial skin, has far fewer sebaceous glands, and shows the visible effects of fluid retention, pigment changes and collagen loss earliest — typically combining a vasoconstrictive or lymphatic-supporting agent (for puffiness), a brightening/antioxidant agent (for shadowing) and a collagen-signalling agent (for fine lines), reflecting the three distinct mechanisms behind visible eye-area ageing. Its formulation is built around hyaluronic acid conjugated with signal peptides, which draws water into the epidermis via its humectant carboxyl groups while the peptide fraction supports dermal collagen signalling. Pat a small amount around the orbital bone, avoiding direct contact with the eye, morning and/or night; visible improvement in puffiness is typically faster than in fine lines, which depend on the slower process of collagen remodelling.

products.description: A soap-free, sulphate-gentle cleansing base formulated with humectant and emollient co-actives to offset the barrier-stripping effect that surfactant cleansing typically has on body skin — body skin has a thicker stratum corneum than facial skin but is exposed to hotter water and stronger surfactants during daily bathing, both of which accelerate barrier lipid loss over time. products.description: A dual-action wash combining a surfactant cleansing base with chemical or physical exfoliating agents that accelerate the shedding of built-up dead skin on the body — body skin renews more slowly than facial skin and is more prone to visible dullness and keratosis-type roughness, particularly on the arms and legs, making periodic exfoliation useful for maintaining an even surface texture.
